capabilities.description: Authoritative room containing the actor.
Authoritative room membership changed.
Server-validated station-wide training console signal; explicit audience and stable signal identity.
Controlled actor's private task assignment and authoritative state; empty when unassigned, never contains diagnostic secrets.
Public station calibration progress without participant assignments or authorization secrets.
Private server-created assignment for one task participant.
Authoritative task lifecycle delivered only to assigned participants.
Request a cooperative calibration with a distinct technician; the server assigns both participants.
Request private short-lived diagnostic authorization; the server checks Coordinator role and terminal proximity.
Submit task-scoped authorization; the server checks Technician role, console proximity, expiry and code.
Request cancellation of the caller's active cooperative task.
Private requesting-Coordinator interaction result; sensitive short-lived code must never be persisted or publicly reported.
Private authoritative action acceptance/rejection for the requesting actor; separate from local bridge CommandResult.
Controlled actor's server-assigned public duty and role-selection lock.
Public station duties only; never hidden roles or affiliations.
Request a server-validated unique station duty while role selection is unlocked.
Private correlated authoritative result of duty selection.
Public cooling and incident progress; contains no hidden origin or role-private evidence.
Public authoritative cooling incident alarm without a hidden-origin field.
Public authoritative incident lifecycle; resolution requires both repair and validated investigation.
Owner-only expiring evidence legitimately inspected by the controlled role; session-only data, explicit empty view clears old evidence.
Engineer-only request for private cooling diagnostics at the authorized physical console.
Sheriff-only request for a bounded private authorized security-record view.
Private correlated Engineer evidence with server provenance and expiry; never public diagnostics or durable raw evidence.
Private correlated Sheriff evidence with server provenance and expiry; bounded authorized records only.
Engineer-only request to begin a bounded server repair lease using current legitimately inspected evidence.
Cancel the actor's active repair lease and release ongoing physical work.
Request bounded cancellation of the actor's unfinished assigned incident, never erase a resolved incident.
Server-validated physical maintenance interaction on a public circuit control; cannot set a hidden incident cause.
Sheriff-only bounded hypothesis submission with both legitimately issued and disclosed incident-scoped evidence references.
Private repair lease result; acceptance starts work, completed confirms physical restoration. Preserve both stages of one correlation.
Private report outcome without the correct hidden origin; report validation alone is not whole-incident resolution.
Private correlated maintenance/cancellation result from the authoritative incident policy.
